patterns.note: Sections are presented as full-width, vertically stacked blocks, often using a dark background image with a subtle overlay to maintain a consistent dark theme and ensure text readability.
A high-contrast dark theme dominates, using deep blacks and dark grays as primary backgrounds, paired with crisp white text and vibrant blue accents for interactive elements and highlights.
The site consistently uses a clean, modern sans-serif typeface for all text, with large, prominent headings that establish a strong visual hierarchy against the dark backgrounds.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background city graphic moves slower than the foreground elements, creating depth as the user scrolls.
Key navigation elements (main header and a floating chat icon) remain sticky at the top and side of the viewport respectively, providing persistent access.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect, where the background image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, enhancing the sense of depth. Subsequent content sections are designed to animate into view, typically with a subtle fade-up or slide-in motion, as they enter the user's viewport, creating a dynamic reveal experience, likely using CSS keyframes. The main navigation bar and a floating action button are fixed to the viewport, ensuring constant accessibility.

The visual design relies on full-bleed sections, many featuring high-resolution background imagery with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure white text remains highly legible. Interactive elements like buttons and links are styled with thin outlines and a bright blue accent color against the dark backdrop, maintaining a minimal yet distinct appearance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, clean sans-serif headings (hero text ~3-4x body) with a modern character, complemented by highly legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout for all interactive elements and content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero section, transitioning to a balanced density for content blocks, maintaining clear visual separation.

standout: This site's design stands out with its sophisticated dark theme, effectively using high-contrast imagery and subtle parallax to create an immersive and premium feel. The consistent use of a deep black background paired with crisp white typography and vibrant blue accents gives it a distinctive, modern authority.
